Actual judging instructions exercise those states: Render judge.toml:25 requires new authored DOM/log output through Run; Functional prompt.md:145-161 waits beyond six seconds, clicks, focuses/types, Stops and compares actual output; :164-182 waits past callback deadlines after supersession/Stop; :238-267 performs finite controls then looping runs and visible deadline waits; :306-355 waits for timer errors and Promise failures; :372-388 expands objects, appends/clears history and measures a delayed run; :394-400 edits across an observed debounce, toggles off before a queued deadline, waits and manually runs; :461 toggles both directions and compares chrome/editor/console and exact work; :465-475 batches a ten-second nested-callback observation. Their matching outcome definitions are in Functional judge.toml:70,77,84,91,98,168,273,287,301-322,427-448. Polish prompt.md:45-49 requires actual keyboard traversal and view changes, and Polish judge.toml:23 requires reaching and using each pane at roughly 390 by 844. Visual prompt.md:17-22,44-46 and judge.toml:99 require desktop/mobile comparisons and both offered themes. These cannot be established from first paint alone. Raw supporting evidence was inspected, not merely its pass flags: post-results.json facts[S03.later_interactions].evidence records waits of 6101.2477 ms and 6102.5791 ms with click count 0->1 and then key/input counts 0->1; S17 records initial automatic execution after 560.3088 ms, eleven edits across about 1470 ms, no intermediate execution and final execution after 541.2943 ms, plus full 3000-ms off/queued-cancellation windows. pre-results.json S34 records changed chrome/editor/console colours in the middle appearance and restoration of original colours, with exact before/middle/after work equal. surface_flow.cjs:31-34 actually clicks theme, sets 390x844, edits/runs and clears; surface-results.json records that viewport and resulting mobile-preview with mobile-console cleared. Its keyboard route uses actual keys and records the distinct example and saved source. This is a source-procedure Pass with supporting direct pinned-Playwright evidence. The raw index explicitly states full configured judge completion/workload, Oracle, Luna and empirical configured reward ranking were not measured; none is inferred here. Runtime execution of the configured judging agent is therefore only PARTIAL evidence, not a claim of task clearance or a score.
counterexample: Attempted false-pass reasoning: a static editor/preview with a no-op Run fails the new-marker Render action; a theme control changing only its label fails S34 actual appearance changes; a runner whose handlers die at five seconds fails S03 delayed click/key/input; a throttle that executes intermediate edits fails the timed S17 sequence; fixed desktop panes that hide controls at 390px fail the reach/use check. None is allowed to earn the relevant credit from initial appearance. Attempted false-fail reasoning: a conforming mobile implementation using tabs/drawers, intentional pane scrolling, a light initial theme, native keyboard controls and a static restored preview after Stop remains explicitly permitted (Polish judge.toml:23, prompt.md:29,47-49; Functional prompt.md:17,159-160,461; Visual judge.toml:99). No specific layout, theme default, debounce interval or post-Stop live handlers are imposed. These are review counterexamples, not newly executed mutation runs.
